parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the container cluster.

parameters.name: Types
parameters.description:
The type of the vulnerabilities. Valid values:

*   **cve**: Linux software vulnerabilities
*   **app**: application vulnerabilities
*   **sca**: vulnerabilities that are detected based on software component analysis

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-cluster-vul-statistics --cluster-id c471f0f61b9c04f8380556e922cf10000 --types cve,app,sca --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
